description: This file defines a Java interface named ProvisioningCategoryWritePlatformService, which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting provisioning categories within the Apache Fineract project. It includes method signatures that accept JSON commands and return command processing results.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryWritePlatformService
